tools.name: PixFlux
tools.changelog:
Initial release.
- PNG ↔ JPEG ↔ WebP
- Batch conversion
- Quality control
tools.description: Convert PNG, JPEG, and WebP files locally. Adjust quality, preserve transparency, batch convert in one go.

tools.name: CropFlow
tools.description: Resize, crop, and compress images with pixel precision. Aspect-ratio lock, custom dimensions, file-size targets.

tools.name: PaperFlow
tools.changelog:
Initial release.
- PDF merge / split
- Rotate & reorder pages
- Images → PDF
tools.description: Merge, split, rotate, and convert PDFs and documents — all without uploading a single page.

tools.name: QrFlux
tools.description: Generate styled QR codes and scan them from your camera or an uploaded image — completely offline.

tools.name: CryptSilo
tools.changelog:
Initial release.
- MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512
- Password generator with entropy meter
tools.description: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes and create strong, cryptographically random passwords.

tools.name: PrismPick
tools.description: Pick colors from any image, extract palettes, and preview combinations — perfect for designers.

tools.name: VidFlux
tools.description: Convert between common video formats right in your browser. Works offline once loaded.
